_metadata.texto_original: Choose 4 creatures loyal to this character, from your pack or from another one. If their original pack agrees to it, these 5 creatures form a pack action. Draw 3 cards. The original owner of the characters may choose to play cards for his creatures and earn the victory points from the kills they make.
